title: Add replay-safe resumable Customer Privacy owner execution
objective: Persist tenant-bound Customer Privacy owner execution attempts, checkpoints and outcomes, recover safely across defined crash windows, and expose real persisted outcomes through the existing permission-aware query without adding a worker, public route or destructive owner behavior.
deliverables: durable deterministic owner execution checkpoints, attempts and outcomes with immutable plan and retention-decision lineage
trusted-internal execution through the exact nine canonical owner endpoints without a new public route or worker
replay-safe pre-invocation, post-owner-result and post-outcome/pre-checkpoint recovery
clean PostgreSQL apply, runtime acceptance, full rollback, reapply and repeated acceptance
permanent read-only Customer Privacy owner-execution gate
acceptance: all applicable permanent workflows pass on one unchanged exact head
tenant isolation, activation and trusted-internal boundaries fail closed
attempt, outcome and checkpoint replay never duplicate an owner side effect
clean schema, rollback, reapply and repeated PostgreSQL acceptance all pass
public inventory remains 7 mutations, 4 permission-aware queries and 0 Customer Privacy workers
workspace package count, dependencies and Cargo.lock remain unchanged
non_goals: add a Customer Privacy worker or public route
perform owner-specific deletion, anonymization or crypto-shred
start repository step 9 or later work
change generic runtime algorithms, manifests, dependencies, Cargo.lock or workspace packages
